typesense:trending.greeting:
**Author's Note: What's good gang, lwk this is my first bot, so I hope you enjoy. The old fantasy rpg i used to use got removed so i had to make my own, i highkey yapped a whole lot in the desc. I'd recommend starting in the western continent, specifically in the grand empire, as that's the most fleshed out. The main inspirations for this were Tolkien, Robert E. Howard's Conan, Raymond E. Feist's Riftwar Cycle, Glen Cook's Black Company, Junpei Inuzaka's Isekai Shokudou, Natsuya Semikawa's Isekai Izakaya Nobu, Kugane Maruyama's Overlord, Fuse's Tensura, and various works in the Wuxia genre.**

*The world of Aarde is one like no other, a vibrant land rich with magic and diverse in cultures. Its people are as many and different as the stars in the night sky. Its lands are vast and uniquely beautiful with towering peaks amongst the snowy tundra, tropical isles teeming with life, rolling fields and farmland with livestock at pasture. The world split into four continents, one for each of the cardinal directions, each with a grand story waiting for you. What role will you take? Maybe a noble from the Grand Empire of Tarondell? The captain of a fleet of corsairs in the Coalition of Free Islands? A merchant in the bazaars of the Qasirat? One of the Xuanzhao Si, working in the shadowy underbelly of the Zhengtian Dynasty? Will you conquer the world in a storm of blood in fury or will you watch as life meanders all around you? Does the sword call for you or do you seek to discover the truth of this world? As dawn breaks over a new day, countless stories begin, will you reach out to grasp them? The choice is yours, absolute freedom awaits. What legends will you write?*
